resources.string: Up before your alarm
Asks whether to dismiss your alarm when you\'re up before it. Dawnly only dismisses it on its own if you choose Warn first or Right away.
Up already?
Looks like you\'re awake. Dismiss your %1$s alarm?
Dismissing your %1$s alarm in 1 minute.
You\'re up, so your %1$s alarm can go. Tap Dismiss alarm.
Dismiss alarm
Not yet
That alarm time has passed, so nothing was dismissed.
That alarm is already off.
That alarm was already dismissed or changed, so nothing was dismissed.
%1$s can\'t take dismiss requests. Dismiss your alarm here.
No Clock app found. Your alarm will still ring.
Your %1$s alarm is off. You\'re all set.
Alarm\'s off
Alarm dismissed
Says when Dawnly has dismissed your alarm, playing your sound backwards so you know without looking.
Alarm dismissed right away
With Right away on, says Dawnly has dismissed your alarm, playing your sound so you know without looking.
Your reminders: %1$s
The reminders you set on Today, like drinking water.
Reminders that ring
Reminders set to ring like an alarm. Dawnly plays their sound itself, repeating until you stop or snooze it.
Missed: %1$s
Still up?
Dawnly turned off your %1$s alarm. Tap I\'m up, or it rings in %2$d minutes.
Just checking you didn\'t drift back off. No answer in %1$d minutes and your alarm rings.
I\'m up
Rise and shine
You didn\'t answer Still up?, so here\'s your alarm after all.
Still up? check
Asks once after Dawnly turns off your alarm, in case you fell back asleep. No answer and the alarm rings.
Wake to music
Says when music played instead of your alarm. Silent, so it doesn\'t talk over the song.
Good morning, music\'s on
Your %1$s alarm is off. The music is doing the waking today.
Music\'s on. Tap to turn off your %1$s alarm.
Music\'s playing for this reminder.
Your alarm is still on
%1$s didn\'t turn off your %2$s alarm. Tap to turn it off in %1$s.
%1$s didn\'t turn off your %2$s alarm yet. Dawnly will try again at %3$s, or tap to turn it off in %1$s.
Couldn\'t dismiss
Says when your Clock app didn\'t turn off your alarm, so you know it will still ring.
